sections.name: Evening — a friend, feelings and plans

events.text: Lesson Twenty. A café on Sukhumvit. You're meeting a new friend for the first time. She speaks first — the second voice is you. Listen.

Ten lines, and you already had every word. Today is one long day in Bangkok, in Thai. First, some memory work.

Only three new things today, and all of them are small. First — when someone thanks you. You know never mind. Here's the warmer one: my pleasure. Listen.
